tldr: Venus in Aquarius: love needs friendship, freedom, and respect for difference.
body: With Venus in Aquarius, attraction grows through mental connection, shared ideals, and room to be unconventional. You value bonds that do not demand conformity.
gift: Friendship, originality, social awareness, and love that honors individuality.
challenge: Detachment, unpredictability, and acting above attachment when the heart is involved.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
